entities.name: Church of the Holy Mother of God, Bolshiye Saly

entities.summary: The Church of the Holy Mother of God is an Armenian Apostolic church in Bolshiye Saly village, Myasnikovsky District, Rostov Oblast, Russia. It is also officially declared as an architectural monument of regional significance of cultural heritage of Russia.
